name: The Incense Vigil
pitch: Switch your ward off, let every blow become a slow wound, stand forty seconds against a god and win by law, then pay for it in decades of your life.

new.name: Incense Vow
new.effect: A stalemate is a win when the other side opened the fight. Closes: your hits deal nothing, and you cannot start a fight.
new.second_home: a healer who wins by keeping a fight going; sect gate guardians

new.name: Slow Wound
new.effect: Hit damage past ward and guard enters a ledger. The ledger pays at most dot_pool_cap of maximum health a pulse, after ticks, on its own cap.
new.second_home: any tick clock that must outlive its own clock, as a partial share

new.name: Still Sea
new.effect: The Slow Wound cap falls by 0.55 x your linh lực share.

new.name: Years Owed
new.effect: At the fight's end each 100 % of maximum health left in the ledger costs 1 % of the realm's base lifespan.
new.second_home: anything else a cap clips and a life could pay for

new.name: Short Stick
new.effect: Foreseen fights only: time_limit falls by half.
new.second_home: any burst build hunting Late Bloom or a tick clock

new.name: Turned Blade
new.effect: With no hit to deal, half your L1 and L3 points add to body_guard_pct.

new.name: Amber
new.effect: Convergence of Wood and Earth. Per purity: +0.45 body_guard_pct, -0.10 cultivation_speed_pct. 11.5 W at purity 50, 23 W at 100.

new.name: Standing Stele Sutra
new.effect: Main, Địa giai, Earth and Wood. Carries Slow Wound, Years Owed and the three curses.

new.name: Stale Incense
new.effect: Curse, cost 0.04, 3 s: enemy art costs +50 % for 5 pulses.

new.name: Closed Gate
new.effect: Curse, cost 0.04, 3 s: blocks enemy regeneration for 5 pulses.

new.name: Stilled Hand
new.effect: Curse, cost 0.04, 3 s: locks one enemy layer for 2 pulses.

new.name: Short Stick Incense
new.effect: The prepared item that carries Short Stick. Foreseen fights only.

new.name: Unmoved Body
new.effect: Body refinement, Earth, outer, sealed by a technique, size 10. Notables Still Sea and Iron Marrow.

new.name: Way of Keeping
new.effect: Requirement Earth at purity 40 and a body technique. Branches The Gate, The Held Breath, The Long Count. Keystone Incense Vow.

new.name: Deferred damage
new.effect: A ledger of hit damage paid at the pulse on its own cap. Combat rules 4, 14, Formulas C, F.

new.name: Winning by standing
new.effect: A stalemate can be a win for the side that did not open the fight. Combat rule 14, Edge Cases, AC-CB-62.

questions: Combat lists stalling to time_limit as a degenerate strategy. Is a stall that costs decades and cannot start a fight acceptable, or should it live on NPC guardians only?
Does the Slow Wound ledger carry between Heavenly Tribulation waves?
